msg.settle.note_dead: The fallen still make the board (ranked on cumulative expenditure, their four state columns reading 0) — staying alive is not the passing grade; seeing it through counts.
msg.settle.note_dims: GDP = production-side estimate per turn (base prices); Strength = Σ HP% × unit weight ({inf} {w_inf} / {cav} {w_cav} / {mil} {w_mil}); Territory = tile count; Assets = rebuilding cost (base prices) — the last four columns only state what is, they take no part in the ranking.
msg.settle.note_real: Only what was truly spent counts: market trades and gifts do not (bought goods are booked when they are consumed), and neither does inventory (hoarding is not consumption) — so the nation that hoards sits at the bottom of this board.
msg.settle.note_spend: Basis: Total Expenditure = cumulative construction + recruitment + military upkeep, every item converted to gold at the market price of the moment — the spine of expenditure-side GDP (investment + government consumption; this game has no household sector, so no C).

msg.settle.version_mismatch: Save version mismatch (file says {have}, this code is {want}): settlement refuses to score an old save. Rerun a game with the current code.
msg.settle.warn_no_spend: ⚠ This save carries no spending records (Total Expenditure is only booked from the version that introduced the ledger) — settle a newer save.
